advisory_items.detail: execute_t7.py:352 sets legal_unresolved_is_severe_defect = (classification == 'LEGAL_UNRESOLVED'), so both LEGAL_UNRESOLVED diagnostic records carry true while MISSING_REQUIRED_EVIDENCE records carry false. That is the literal opposite of A-1 requirement (b). Every decision and counting path is correct (six_gate_targets.severe_defect_miss excludes the legal UNRESOLVED from the denominator, counted_severe_defect_repair_count=0, legal_unresolved_counted_as_severe_defect=false, hard gate critical_or_severe_defect_miss=UNRESOLVED_NOT_EVALUABLE), so nothing is promoted on the wrong semantics; but a mechanical reader of the delivered evidence field would conclude the opposite of what A-1 requires, and the field sits in the artifact documenting the A-1 diagnostic.
advisory_items.impact: downstream consumers that read paired_replay.json field-by-field can re-import the exact error A-1 was created to remove.
advisory_items.required_before_next_r_evaluation: bind the field's real meaning in the ledger (class marker, not a severity assertion), or replace the record with a correctly named field in a new run package; never retrofit the delivered run.
advisory_items.title: paired_replay.json field legal_unresolved_is_severe_defect is literally inverted for the LEGAL_UNRESOLVED records
advisory_items.why_not_blocking: the candidate is NOT_EVALUABLE and the run is NO_PROMOTION; no severe-miss metric, count, or gate decision depends on the mislabeled field. Under the same rule T6R-01 applied to its ADVISORY-1 (nothing activated, nothing promoted), a mislabeled evidence field is an advisory. A stricter reading that treats it as a violation of the T7 hard precondition is defensible and left to the acceptor.

dissent.text: Acceptance is granted, but two reservations are recorded. First, ADVISORY-1 is not cosmetic: a delivered evidence field literally asserts that a legal UNRESOLVED condition is a severe defect, which is the exact error T6R-01 ADVISORY-1 made a hard precondition for T7. The decision and counting paths are correct, so nothing is promoted on the wrong semantics, but if the closer or the owner prefers to read 'the A-1 hard precondition must hold in every delivered record' strictly, treating this as blocking is defensible and would require a corrected record in a new run package rather than a ledger note. Second, the paired-replay claim is only exit-code level for the dispatch family; T1-INC-01/02/11 are currently detected with an additional watcher-execute-bit failure that T4 never observed, so the 22/22 figure should not be cited as behavior-level reproduction outside its stated scope. Neither reservation changes the NO_PROMOTION outcome, which is conservative and independently confirmed.

justification: Every headline claim of the T7 delivery reproduces independently from the delivered bytes. Counts and integrity: 58 delivered files with 57/57 manifest sha256/bytes/mode recomputed, the manifest self-exclusion policy holding, exactly 3x100755 (build_manifest.py, execute_t7.py, self_check.py) and 55x100644 agreeing across worktree, .git/index and the HEAD tree, and byte-derived git blob SHA-1 equal to both index and HEAD for all 58 files. NO_PROMOTION is legally founded: the T5 v3 closed vocabulary has exactly three operations whose path enums allow a single value each, so the E-03 requirement (an absent-block markdown plus REJECT with an explicit missing-receipt-block code) is unrepresentable, and the underlying guard silently skips rc=0 on an absent block (independently reproduced). Twelve alternative implementation attempts built by this review (enum substitution, parameter injection, appended/removed/reordered operations, a forged absence operation, absolute and traversal paths, and using the dispatch precheck for absence) are all fail-closed with no target execution, so no feasible path was ignored by the run. Six-gate attribution is honest: severe-miss is reported UNRESOLVED_NOT_EVALUABLE and evidence completeness FAIL for the correct reason (vocabulary boundary), and A1 is self-reported FAIL with 0/2 counted repairs and an unavailable cost branch. A-1 satisfies T6R-01 ADVISORY-1: the a/b split exists as a four-class classification policy, legal UNRESOLVED is excluded from the severe denominator and never zero-filled, and the problem family is re-anchored to SUMMARY_GUARD_ABSENT_REQUIRED_RECEIPT_BLOCK with an explicit applicability reason and unchanged T1-INC-14 status; the amendment file predates every evaluation step (03:02:45Z versus 03:17:08-09Z). The rollback drill restores three T5 v3 parent files byte-, mode- and blob-identical to source, re-executes the parent validation a second time on the restored validator with ACCEPTED_WITHIN_SCOPE both times, and leaves all 11 old-evidence bytes/sha256/git-blob/mode snapshots unchanged with before equal to after. Paired replay holds at its stated level: 16/16 case identity fields equal between T1 v3 and T4 v2, 22/22 exit codes equal to T4 declared exit_codes, four log spot checks agreeing with T4 tool output, and T1-INC-12's derive replay reproducing T4's derived markdown SHA-256 exactly. Discipline holds: zero model/network/remote/production/database/training/daemon/Loop B calls with the single strong request left for this Loop C review, execution_chat_usage kept UNRESOLVED, TASK_PROMPT.md byte-identical to the dispatch prompt, three axes DELIVERED/UNREVIEWED/NOT_ENABLED with no self-filled ACCEPTED, and only negated experiment/scientific-success phrasing. The residual defects are evidence-record quality issues (an inverted field name in paired_replay.json, a repair history that cannot be reconciled across three artifacts, G1 reported as 5/5 rc=0 when all five are silent skips, and dispatch-family failure-reason drift), none of which feeds a promotion decision, which is why the decision is ACCEPTED with advisories rather than blocking.
